name: ticketing
description: Read and update tickets in an issue-tracking system (Jira/Linear-style).

tools.name: search_tickets
tools.description: Search tickets by project, status, or free-text query.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on an existing ticket.

tools.name: transition_status
tools.description: Move a ticket to a new status (e.g. 'In Progress' -> 'Done'). Deliberately its own permission, separate from commenting — an agent that can explain itself shouldn't automatically be trusted to also change ticket state.
